title: Home cook marketplace
summary: Order home-cooked meals from people in your neighbourhood.
whyTempting: Home cooking is authentic and cooks want income.
whyItFails: Food safety regulation. Selling home-cooked food is restricted in most jurisdictions. Supply consistency. Hobby cooks don't cook reliably. Low order frequency. Customers revert to known delivery apps.
whatWouldChange: Cottage food law reforms and shared commercial kitchens.

attempts.notes: Network for home-cooked meals in Oakland; cooks got cease-and-desist orders and the company ran out of resources to push for a law change.

reasons.detail: Food safety regulation: Selling home-cooked food is restricted in most jurisdictions.
Supply consistency: Hobby cooks don't cook reliably.
Low order frequency: Customers revert to known delivery apps.
